cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the overseas job or opening this shop with me. You said we'd build something together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said that before I got the offer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then decide what together means now. I'll run the counter if you'll still do the accounts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're making a job abroad sound like leaving you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your share and do the accounts from there. Or let me buy you out, and I'll stop calling that promise a business plan.

reason: Turn abstract promise interpretation into two concrete ownership choices, offering remote participation to retain B cooperation before defining a buyout differently.
